title: Agri dept: PH has sufficient chicken, pork supply despite El Niño threat
summary: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. assured the public on Friday that there is enough food supply in the country despite the looming impact of El Niño on crops and livestock.
